The Program Manager (Branch Manager for Field Services) in the Real Estate Management Division, Facilities and Administration, Mission Support, Transportation Security Administration (TSA), Department of Homeland Security (DHS).

Duties include but are not limited to: Duties include: Provides overall leadership and supervision for the division, including planning, communicating vision and objectives, setting priorities, managing budget and resources, recruiting and developing staff, approving leave, and taking corrective/disciplinary actions.

Ensures workforce alignment with organizational goals and manages a multi-sector workforce. Leads, directs, and exercises broad authority over all phases of real estate management policies, strategic planning, and program operations for TSA.

Provides innovative leadership in establishing and implementing comprehensive real estate management strategies. Oversees activities related to TSA's leased and owned real estate portfolios, including lease acquisition, administration, facilities operations and maintenance, construction, and real estate disposition.

Supervises a team of Realty Services Managers (RSM) who direct, implement, coordinate, and oversee a national real estate program requiring a wide range of management support principles, processes and systems. The RSMs manage initiations and renewals of leases, which require a complex process of negotiations between and approvals by the parties.

Provides oversight and management direction for contracted functions, ensuring efficient and effective use of public and private resources in support of TSA's mission.

Implements policies and procedures to reduce TSA's real estate footprint through space consolidation and utilization, and operational costs by deploying energy efficiency tools, consistent with OMB guidance.

Collaborates with TSA office directors and interacts with senior leaders within TSA, DHS, GSA, and service providers to ensure operational facility requirements are prudently executed and managed.

Administers a diverse, enterprise-wide real estate portfolio, ensuring full compliance with federal leasing regulations, lease expirations, and portfolio performance metrics. Manages and executes over 500 GSA leases, ensuring terms are negotiated in the best financial interest of the agency.

Navigates the GSA Reimbursable Work Authorization process, ensuring accurate funding data, budget tracking, and timely execution of tenant improvement projects. Provides proactive, outstanding customer service and real estate solutions to field real estate locations, addressing space requirements and facility concerns and improvements.

Conducts special real estate projects and complex analyses, as assigned by the Director, requiring a comprehensive knowledge of program management. Supervisory/Managerial duties includes serving as a first line supervisor for the organization.

This includes but is not limited to: assigning work, setting priorities, and reviewing and evaluating work and performance of subordinates; approving leave; coaching and developing employees; recommending corrective or disciplinary actions; assisting in budget planning and projecting short-term needs; managing projects within assigned resources; resolving routine problems that typically impact the objectives of the organizational unit; and when required, coordinating with customers outside the immediate organization.
To qualify for the SV-K Pay Band (equivalent to GS-15), you must have one year of specialized experience at the SV-J or GS-14 in the Federal service or equivalent experience in the private sector.

Specialized experience is defined as experience that has equipped you with the knowledge, skills and abilities to successfully perform the duties of the position.

Specialized experience is defined as: Knowledge of federal laws, regulations, policies, and procedures related to real estate management, leasing, facilities operations, and asset disposition. Experience in managing multi-layered, geographically dispersed organizations with varied missions and functional requirements.

Credit for experience is given based on a 40-hour workweek. Part-time experience is credited on a part-time ratio, i.e., working 20 hours per week for two months equals one month of experience. No additional credit is given for overtime.

National Service Experience (i.e., volunteer experience): Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations (e.g., professional; philanthropic; religious; spiritual; community, student, social).

Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment. You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer experience.

This position as a Natural Resource Manager, is an outstanding opportunity for a candidate with skills in Geospatial technologies, biological sciences, ecology, or other environmental sciences. Employee will serve as the Natural Resource Manager of the Ice Age National Scenic Trail (NST).

The position is in Cross Plains, Wisconsin, is supervised by the Trail Manager for the Ice Age NST, with an office building situated on NPS Property along the Ice Ace Age NST route. The NPS property is located within and makes up some acreage of the larger Cross Plains Ice Age National Scientific Reserve and State Park.

The Ice Age NST is a premier recreational footpath that generally follows the edge of the last glacial advance in Wisconsin. The Ice Age NST is administered and managed in partnership between the National Park Service (NPS), Wisconsin Department of Natural Resources (WDNR), and Ice Age Trail Alliance (IATA).

When completed, the Ice Age NST will meander for approximately 1,200 miles through Wisconsin, from Potawatomi State Park in Door County to Interstate State Park in Polk County. Today, approximately 700 miles of the Ice Age NST have been constructed and are open for use.

The Ice Age NST preserves outstanding landscapes and landscape features, resulting from continental glaciation. The National Park Service is responsible for overall administration, planning, compliance, interpretation, signage, and some land acquisition.

At the full performance level (GS-09) the major duties of this position include, but are not limited to the following: Carry out provisions of the National Trails System Act (P.L. 90-543, as amended) pertaining to the geospatial aspect of planning and administering of the Ice Age NST.

Administers all functions related to ArcGIS, technical support, and collecting data with GPS while proposing creative ways to use technology to advance development of the trail and advanced interpretation. Creates presentations of findings and effectively communicates project details to interested parties, partners, and members of the public.

Develop project workplans and implementation strategies leading to the accomplishment of restoration efforts, trail development, mitigation actions, and participate as a member of the planning and interdisciplinary team.

Interprets variables, trends, correlations, and interrelationships between data and conditions of work projects and provides reports to managers and interested parties.

Encourages and facilitates cooperation, pride, trust, and teamwork mentality that fosters the commitment to the Ice Age National Scenic Trail and supports the goals established with partners. Duties will be developmental in nature when filled below the full performance level.

Wir unterstützen Praxen, Kliniken und weitere Unternehmen der Gesundheitsbranche dabei, qualifizierte Mitarbeitende zu gewinnen, interne Strukturen zu optimieren und nachhaltiges Wachstum aufzubauen.
Dabei verbinden wir strategische Beratung mit konsequenter operativer Umsetzung. Unser Anspruch sind messbare Ergebnisse, eine verlässliche Kundenbetreuung und Lösungen, die nicht nur auf dem Papier funktionieren, sondern den Arbeitsalltag unserer Kunden langfristig verbessern.
Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir einen Projektmanager (m/w/d), der Kundenprojekte eigenverantwortlich steuert, interne Fachbereiche koordiniert und dafür sorgt, dass vereinbarte Maßnahmen strukturiert, termingerecht und mit einem hohen Qualitätsanspruch umgesetzt werden.
Aufgaben
Eigenverantwortliche Projektsteuerung: Du übernimmst die Planung, Koordination und Umsetzung unserer Kundenprojekte – vom Onboarding bis zum erfolgreichen Projektabschluss.
Kunden-Onboarding und Bedarfsanalyse: Du führst strukturierte Kick-off-Gespräche, erfasst Ziele und Anforderungen unserer Kunden und überführst diese in konkrete Projektpläne und Maßnahmen.
Zentrale Kundenkommunikation: Du bist während der gesamten Zusammenarbeit eine verbindliche Ansprechperson für unsere Kunden, koordinierst Rückfragen und stellst eine schnelle und professionelle Kommunikation sicher.
Koordination interner Fachbereiche: Du arbeitest eng mit den Bereichen Recruiting, Beratung, Marketing, Vertrieb und Kundenmanagement zusammen und sorgst für einen reibungslosen Informationsfluss.
Projektplanung und Priorisierung: Du definierst Aufgaben, Zuständigkeiten, Meilensteine und Fristen und stellst sicher, dass alle Beteiligten ihre nächsten Schritte kennen.
Fortschritts- und Qualitätskontrolle: Du überwachst Projektstände, Ergebnisse und relevante Kennzahlen, erkennst Abweichungen frühzeitig und leitest geeignete Maßnahmen ein.
Meeting- und Aufgabenmanagement: Du bereitest Kundenmeetings und interne Projektbesprechungen vor, dokumentierst Entscheidungen und verfolgst vereinbarte Aufgaben konsequent nach.
Prozessoptimierung: Du identifizierst Verbesserungspotenziale in bestehenden Abläufen und wirkst aktiv an der Entwicklung effizienter und skalierbarer Prozesse mit.
Reporting und Auswertungen: Du erstellst Präsentationen, Projektberichte, Statusübersichten und Entscheidungsgrundlagen für Kunden, Fachbereiche und Geschäftsführung.
Kundenentwicklung: Du erkennst zusätzliche Bedarfe und Optimierungsmöglichkeiten und entwickelst gemeinsam mit unseren Beratern passende Lösungen für den weiteren Erfolg unserer Kunden.
Ressourcen- und Budgetsteuerung: Du unterstützt bei der sinnvollen Verteilung von Kapazitäten und behältst projektbezogene Budgets, Zeitaufwände und wirtschaftliche Ziele im Blick.
Sicherstellung unserer Qualitätsstandards: Du sorgst dafür, dass alle Projekte professionell dokumentiert, zuverlässig umgesetzt und mit einem hohen Service- und Qualitätsanspruch betreut werden.
Qualifikation
Du verfügst über ein abgeschlossenes Studium, beispielsweise in Betriebswirtschaft, Wirtschaftspsychologie, Personalmanagement, Marketing oder Projektmanagement, eine abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation/ Erfahrung
Du bringst idealerweise erste Berufserfahrung im Projektmanagement, in einer Unternehmensberatung, Personalberatung, Recruiting-Agentur, Marketing-Agentur oder im Account Management mit
Du hast Erfahrung in der strukturierten Planung und Steuerung mehrerer parallel laufender Projekte.Du arbeitest sicher mit gängigen Office-Anwendungen, digitalen Kommunikationstools sowie Projektmanagement- und CRM-Systemen.
Du kannst Kennzahlen, Projektstände und Arbeitsergebnisse analysieren und verständlich aufbereiten.Du bist in der Lage, professionelle Präsentationen, Dokumentationen und Entscheidungsvorlagen zu erstellen.

Kenntnisse in den Bereichen Recruiting, Personalvermittlung, digitales Marketing oder Gesundheitswesen sind hilfreich, aber keine zwingende Voraussetzung.

Umfangreiche Weiterbildung: Interne Trainings, Gruppencoachings, Masterclasses, Lernvideos, individuelle Kurse sowie die Möglichkeit, Fachmessen und externe Veranstaltungen zu besuchen.

Attraktive Vergütung: Eine leistungsorientierte und überdurchschnittliche Vergütung mit Entwicklungsperspektive.

Moderner Arbeitsplatz: Helle, klimatisierte Büroräume in den Bavaria Towers in München-Bogenhausen mit einem professionellen und inspirierenden Arbeitsumfeld.
Gute Erreichbarkeit: Direkte Anbindung an den öffentlichen Nahverkehr und die A94 sowie kostenfreie Parkmöglichkeiten.
Wellpass und Fitnessmöglichkeiten: Angebote zur Förderung Deiner Gesundheit und körperlichen Fitness.
Kostenlose Verpflegung: Kostenlose Getränke, Kaffee und Snacks am Arbeitsplatz.
Teamveranstaltungen und Reisen: Regelmäßige Firmenevents, Trainings, Veranstaltungen und Teamreisen mit Unternehmern, Speakern und Branchenexperten.

Starker Zusammenhalt: Ein ambitioniertes und diverses Team, das Verantwortung übernimmt, hohe Qualitätsansprüche verfolgt und gemeinsam wachsen möchte.
Arbeit mit echtem Einfluss: Deine Arbeit wirkt sich unmittelbar auf die Qualität unserer Kundenprojekte, den Erfolg unserer Partnerunternehmen und die Entwicklung von Wiese Dental aus.

You will serve as a Technical Project Lead (TPL) for the Afloat Counter Unmanned Systems (ACUS) portfolio.
You will be responsible for the technical baseline and risk management, employing an agile, iterative approach to evaluate emerging technologies and ensure the continuous delivery of safe, authorized, and effective C-UxS solutions.
You will lead technical efforts by coordinating activities across Ship Integration and Certification, Launcher and Gun-Based Effectors, Fire Direction, and Systems Engineering.
You will provide hands-on guidance to a diverse engineering team, ensuring strict adherence to engineering best practices and driving the technical review of all deliverables.
You will lead a cross-functional team to ensure successful project execution and alignment with program and sponsor goals, while fostering collaboration across technical and programmatic disciplines to achieve project success.
You will evaluate emerging technologies and systems to accelerate delivery of rapid capabilities to the Fleet, employing a highly agile, iterative engineering approach focused on continuous/rapid deployment of effective ship self-defense solutions.
You will provide hands-on technical leadership to a diverse engineering team, resolving complex system issues, enforcing engineering best practices, and validating all technical deliverables prior to fleet release.
You will serve as the primary technical engineering authority, owning the engineering approach, driving key design decisions, and actively managing technical risks to ensure system viability.

Klub44 ist ein gemeinnütziges Startup im Bereich digitale Jugendbeteiligung. Mit der Klub-App ermöglichen wir es jungen Menschen, ihre eigene Stadt und ihre Vorlieben zu entdecken, und die Welt um sich herum mitzugestalten. Alle jungen Menschen haben das Recht auf ein freies und schöpferisches Leben, daran glauben wir fest.
Nebenbei möchten wir die Schul- und Berufsbildung radikal transformieren.
Mit der Klub-App erhalten Jugendliche ab 12 Jahren einen chancengerechten Zugang zu kostenfreien Freizeit- und Berufsorientierungsangeboten. Außerschulische Standorte – z. B. Jugendclubs, Makerspaces, Orte der kulturellen Bildung – können auf unserer App ihre Angebote direkt und digital an Jugendliche kommunizieren. Das Ganze bauen wir als Game auf: Entdecke deine Stadt, dich selbst, und bekomme dafür Rewards!
Wir ermutigen ausdrücklich Menschen aller Geschlechter, Religionen und sexuellen Orientierungen dazu, sich bei uns zu bewerben!
Aufgaben
Als Projektmanager*in Kooperationen bist du die Person, bei der unsere operativen Projekte zusammenlaufen. Kommunen, Schulen und Stiftungen arbeiten mit uns, weil sie ein Ergebnis wollen – du sorgst dafür, dass dieses Ergebnis auch eintritt: im Zeitplan, im Budget, und mit zufriedenen Partnern.

Gleichzeitig hast du einen zweiten Auftrag, der genauso wichtig ist: Du führst so viele Projekte wie möglich über unsere Standardprozesse, damit Klub als Plattform skalierbar bleibt und nicht in Sonderlösungen erstickt. Diese Doppelrolle – nach außen verbindlich, nach innen konsequent – ist der Kern des Jobs.
Wir freuen uns auf Mitunternehmer*innen, um gemeinsam mit dem jungen Team und Geschäftsführer Sebastian die Geschicke von Klub44 zu leiten.
Projektsteuerung
Eigenverantwortliche Steuerung unserer laufenden Kooperationsprojekte – von Kick-off bis Abschluss.
Planung von Meilensteinen, Verantwortlichkeiten und Terminen; Nachhalten, wenn es hakt.
Frühzeitiges Erkennen von Risiken und aktives Gegensteuern, statt Überraschungen am Projektende.
Sicherstellen, dass zugesagte Ziele (z. B. teilnehmende Standorte, aktive Jugendliche, Angebots-Uploads) tatsächlich erreicht werden.
Account Management & Partnerbetreuung
Du bist die verlässliche Ansprechperson für unsere Projektpartner in Kommunen, Schulen und Stiftungen – die Stimme von Klub im Alltag.
Aufbau langfristiger Beziehungen: Bestehende Kooperationen erfolgreich umsetzen, verlängern und ausbauen.
Erwartungsmanagement mit Verwaltungen, Schulleitungen und Förderpartnern: klar sagen, was geht, und was nicht.
Übersetzungsarbeit zwischen kommunaler Logik und Startup-Tempo – in beide Richtungen.
Skalierbarkeit & Standardprozesse
Onboarding von Kommunen, Schulen und Jugendeinrichtungen entlang unserer Standardprozesse – wiederholbar statt jedes Mal neu.
Weiterentwicklung dieser Prozesse: Playbooks, Templates, Checklisten, Automatisierungen.
Erkennen, wann eine Partneranfrage ein Sonderfall ist – und wann sie in ein neues Standardangebot gehört.
Bewusstes Nein zu Individuallösungen, die uns langfristig teuer werden.
Zahlen, Reporting & Wirkung
Nachhalten der Projekt-KPIs und transparentes internes Reporting zum Projektstatus.
Aufbereitung von Projektständen und Wirkungsdaten für Zuwendungsgeber und Stiftungen – die Verantwortung für Verwendungsnachweise und Reportings liegt bei der Geschäftsführung, du lieferst die Grundlage.
Ableiten konkreter Maßnahmen aus den Zahlen, nicht nur Dokumentation.
Zusammenarbeit im Team
Enge Abstimmung mit Geschäftsführung, Marketing & Community und Produktentwicklung.
Rückkopplung von Partner-Feedback ins Produkt: Was brauchen Kommunen und Standorte wirklich?
Steuerung externer Partner und Dienstleister im Projektkontext.
Qualifikation
Du hast mehrjährige Erfahrung im Projektmanagement und bringst Projekte nachweislich zum Abschluss – idealerweise mit Partnern aus Verwaltung, Bildung, Stiftungen oder NGOs. Arbeitserfahrung in einem Startup ist ein guter Bonus.
Du bist stark in Kooperation und Kommunikation: Du gewinnst Menschen für gemeinsame Ziele und behältst dabei die Interessen von Klub im Blick.
Du denkst in Prozessen und Systemen, nicht in Einzelfällen – und hast Freude daran, Wiederholbares zu bauen.
Du arbeitest strukturiert und verbindlich: Zusagen, Fristen und Follow-ups sitzen bei dir.
Du bist "hands on" und sicher im Umgang mit agilen Methoden und Projektmanagement-Tools.
Du arbeitest datenbasiert und bist sicher im Nachhalten von Kennzahlen.
Dich motivieren unternehmerische Herausforderungen und du möchtest persönlich dazu beitragen, Jugendliche bei einer chancengerechten Entfaltung ihrer Potenziale zu fördern.
Du hast sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse auf muttersprachlichem Niveau und verhandlungssichere Englischkenntnisse.
Als junges, gemeinnütziges Startup sind wir noch limitiert, wollen aber mittelfristig marktgerecht zahlen. Bis wir das hinkriegen, können wir auch kreativ sein.

Global Trials Optimization Specialist
Sponsor Dedicated/ Remote - US only
Are you energized by using data, planning, and cross-functional collaboration to help clinical trials enroll successfully? We’re seeking a Global Trials Optimization Specialist to support program feasibility, recruitment and retention planning, and in-life trial optimization across global clinical studies.
In this role, you’ll help translate trial goals, country input, modeling data, and enrollment insights into practical strategies that support study execution. You’ll partner with clinical trial teams, vendors, legal, analytics, and other stakeholders to identify enrollment opportunities, address challenges, and support patient- and site-facing recruitment efforts.
This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys combining clinical trial operations, feasibility strategy, recruitment planning, stakeholder coordination, and performance analysis to help studies reach the right participants.

Program Feasibility and Trial Optimization
Gather data, benchmarks, and modeling inputs to support feasibility and trial optimization planning.
Support program review development, including content review and escalation of requirements as needed.
Plan timelines for validation, deliverable development, stakeholder alignment, presentation preparation, and country validation requests.
Support validation and Clinical Trials Allocation Committee activities, including scenario planning, risk table inputs, validation review, modeling updates, and final allocation requests.
Author the initial Global Trials Optimization Report and maintain subsequent report updates throughout the trial lifecycle.
Complete recruitment needs assessments and ensure trial-level GTO reports remain current and actionable.
Recruitment and Retention Planning
Lead early recruitment and retention planning during feasibility, including inputs for project cost estimates.
Develop initial recruitment needs assessments and, where applicable, program-level recruitment budget estimates.
Submit vendor requests and prepare recruitment and retention plans.
Partner with legal on concept reviews, vendor proposal reviews, scope of work finalization, and material or tactic reviews.
Ensure recruitment and retention plans, including enrollment support materials, are implemented effectively.
Oversee enrollment support material development and tactic execution.
Provide required materials to the Metrics, Analytics & Performance team to support accurate Study Optimizer plan entry.
Request and manage appropriate system updates as trial needs evolve.
In-Life Trial Management
Partner with study teams to identify enrollment challenges, assess risks, and recommend potential mitigations.
Manage routine enrollment support materials and vendor activities.
Monitor enrollment performance and prepare standard reporting.
Analyze performance trends and identify opportunities for enhanced support.
Coordinate enhanced enrollment support activities, which may include:
Rescue site and country activities
Internal recruitment and retention refresher meetings
External recruitment and retention booster meetings
Additional participant- or site-facing materials
Rescue vendor engagement
Advocacy engagement and community outreach

Experience supporting clinical trials, feasibility, recruitment planning, enrollment strategy, or trial optimization.
Strong ability to gather, interpret, and apply data to support planning and decision-making.
Experience coordinating timelines, deliverables, stakeholder reviews, and cross-functional inputs.
Ability to work with clinical trial teams, vendors, legal, analytics, and other business partners.
Strong written communication skills, including the ability to develop clear reports, plans, updates, and study-facing materials.
Detail-oriented approach with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced clinical research environment.

Oncology clinical trial experience, especially in lung or breast cancer studies .
Prior experience as an oncology site coordinator .
Experience with recruitment and retention vendors, enrollment support materials, or patient/site-facing recruitment tactics.
Familiarity with enrollment monitoring, performance analysis, country validation, risk tables, or trial allocation processes.
Why This Role Matters
Successful clinical trials depend on reaching the right participants, supporting sites effectively, and responding quickly when enrollment challenges arise. As a Global Trials Optimization Specialist, your work will directly support smarter planning, stronger recruitment strategies, and more effective trial execution.
You’ll have the opportunity to influence global study planning, collaborate with experienced clinical research partners, and help improve how trials connect with patients and sites.
Candidate Profile
We’re especially interested in candidates with oncology trial experience and a strong understanding of site operations, enrollment strategy, and recruitment/retention planning. Internal candidates will be prioritized initially; external candidates may be considered after the initial internal review period.
If you’re a clinical research professional who enjoys bringing structure, insight, and strategy to trial enrollment planning, we’d like to hear from you. Apply today to help support meaningful clinical trials through thoughtful feasibility, recruitment, and optimization work.

Täglich fahren Millionen Autos durch Deutschland, und in den meisten bleibt Platz ungenutzt. Wir ändern das.
MUVN ist ein digitaler Transportmarktplatz. Wir bringen Fahrer:innen mit freiem Laderaum mit Menschen und Unternehmen zusammen, die etwas transportieren müssen. Günstiger, versichert, ohne Umweg.
Wir bauen gerade an mehreren Dingen gleichzeitig: einem neuen Produkt für gewerbliche Versender, Piloten mit großen Marken, neuen Strecken, Integrationen. An jedem dieser Themen arbeiten mehrere Menschen aus mehreren Bereichen, und keiner von ihnen hat den vollen Überblick über alle anderen.
Genau dafür gibt es diese Stelle. Du weißt zu jeder Zeit, wo jedes Projekt steht, was als Nächstes ansteht und wo es gerade klemmt. Eine Frage zum aktuellen Sprint, und du kannst sie beantworten. Eine Frage zu einem Partnerprojekt, und du gehst auf die Leute zu und sorgst dafür, dass am Tag X alles steht.
Du bist kein Product Owner und musst nicht entwickeln können. Du musst verstehen, worum es geht, grob einschätzen können, was etwas bedeutet, und Dinge über die Ziellinie bringen.
Hierfür suchen wir dich ab dem 01.10.2026 als Verstärkung für unser Team in Hamburg 🚀
Aufgaben
Überblick über alle Projekte
Du führst die Timeline über Marktplatz, unser Produkt für gewerbliche Versender, Integrationen und Partnerprojekte. Status, nächster Meilenstein, offene Entscheidungen, Risiken. Alles an einem Ort, aktuell, und für jeden im Team in zwei Minuten auffindbar.
Themen aktiv vorantreiben
Du wartest nicht auf Statusmeldungen, du holst sie dir. Freundlich und hartnäckig, bis erledigt wirklich erledigt heißt.
Abhängigkeiten und Termine
Du erkennst früh, wo sich Themen gegenseitig blockieren, über Tech, Marketing, Operations und externe Partner hinweg. Und du eskalierst konkret: nicht "das wird knapp", sondern "wenn X bis Freitag nicht steht, verschiebt sich Y um zwei Wochen".
Launches und Piloten
Du planst und begleitest den Start neuer Produkte, Features und Partnerprojekte. Wer liefert was bis wann, was muss am Tag X stehen, was lernen wir danach. Und du baust Checklisten, die beim zweiten Mal besser funktionieren als beim ersten.
Schnittstelle zu Tech
Wir sind ein technisches Produkt, deshalb hängt vieles an unserem CTO. Du bist die Schnittstelle zwischen ihm und den laufenden Projekten. Du verstehst genug vom Thema, um in einem Kunden- oder Partnergespräch grob einzuschätzen, was etwas bedeutet, und um die richtige Rückfrage zu stellen.
Ziele und Rhythmus
Du hältst den Takt: Zyklen, Check-ins, Reviews, sichtbarer Fortschritt. Die Ziele setzen die Gründer:innen und die Verantwortlichen. Dass sie nachgehalten werden, liegt bei dir.
Meetings und Entscheidungen
Für deine projektübergreifenden Runden bereitest du vor und nach: Agenda, Unterlagen, Ergebnisse, To-dos mit Verantwortlichem und Datum. Entscheidungen dokumentierst du so, dass sie zwei Wochen später nicht neu verhandelt werden.
Externe Partner
Agenturen, Pilotpartner, Dienstleister. Du steuerst die Zusammenarbeit: Lieferungen, Termine, Feedbackschleifen.
Prozesse und KI
Wiederkehrendes standardisierst du mit Vorlagen und Checklisten. Du arbeitest KI-first: Statusberichte, Protokolle, Recherche und Dokumentation baust du mit KI. Was dabei rauskommt, prüfst du. Die Richtigkeit gehört dir, nicht dem Tool.
Qualifikation
Du hast mindestens zwei Jahre Erfahrung im Projekt- oder Programmmanagement, gerne in einem Startup, einer Agentur oder einem digitalen Produktumfeld. Du hast schon einmal ein Projekt mit mehreren Beteiligten und einem harten Termin über die Ziellinie gebracht, ohne selbst die fachliche Arbeit gemacht zu haben.
Du bist nah dran an digitalen Produkten. Tiefe Technikkenntnisse brauchst du nicht, aber du musst Sachzusammenhänge verstehen und grob einschätzen können, was ein Wunsch bedeutet, bevor du ihn zusagst.

Vous accompagnez nos clients dans la matérialisation, les conseillez sur les solutions techniques et l'ergonomie en cuisine.

Vous avez une formation technique (ébéniste, dessinateur en aménagement intérieur, etc.). Vous possédez des connaissances approfondies en planification de cuisines et un sens créatif. Avec de bonnes compétences en négociation, en communication et en animation, ainsi qu'une bonne dose de détermination, vous accompagnez vos clients en collaboration avec le/la Key Account Manager.

Votre futur poste vous offre la possibilité de mettre en œuvre vos compétences créatives dans un environnement dynamique et innovant. Vous contribuez de manière significative au succès de notre entreprise. Grâce à votre autonomie, votre initiative et votre grand sens des responsabilités, vous travaillez au sein d'une équipe engagée.
Envoyez-nous vos documents de candidature via notre portail d'emploi.

What We're Building Towards
At Omegga, we're on a mission to reinvent how AI and spectroscopy can drive positive change for animals, people and the planet. We started with a clear objective: eliminate chick culling on a global scale through early, non-invasive detection. This outdated practice still impacts billions of lives, and we're here to change that. We're not building for the niche, we're building for the global standard.
Today, our systems are already in use, and the focus is on scaling performance, robustness, and deployment across an international customer base. For us, scaling means more than growth. It means changing an industry for the better.
We are looking for people who take ownership, think in systems, and want to help turn a working product into the industry benchmark. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.

We're looking for a Technical Project Manager who runs our hardware development projects end to end and holds the thread between our engineers, our external partners, and our leadership. Our system combines optics, mechanics, electronics, and embedded control with machine learning on top. Most of what you manage is hardware, but every hardware decision touches software and data science, and you make sure those pieces move together.
Development happens in-house, but parts of it are outsourced to production partners and component suppliers. You keep those external work packages aligned with our internal timelines, specifications, and quality standards. Our Sales Engineering team owns the customer relationship; you make sure their requirements turn into delivered systems.
You take ownership end to end, hold yourself to a high standard, and focus on outcomes that matter for the customer. You communicate openly, give honest feedback, and build trust through your actions.
What You'll Build
Own the plan for our hardware development projects, from concept and prototypes to release for series production
Keep hardware, software, and data science development in sync: interfaces, test campaigns, integration milestones, and releases
Prioritize the integration backlog together with our tech leads and align it with customer commitments
Manage the outsourced parts of our development with production partners and component suppliers: scope, specifications, timelines, and quality
Integrate partner timelines into the overall project plan and resolve conflicts before they become blockers
Plan and coordinate system deployments together with Sales Engineering: installation scheduling, spare parts, and incident handling
Plan and monitor project budgets, track risks, and initiate corrective measures early
Deliver clear, regular reporting on milestones, trial outcomes, and project status to leadership

3 to 5 years of experience in technical project management in a hardware development environment: machinery, medtech, robotics, optics, or comparable
Solid understanding of hardware development, from prototyping to release for small series production
Experience coordinating outsourced development work with manufacturers or key suppliers
Enough understanding of software and data science to spot dependencies to the hardware and plan integration realistically
Experience with project budgets and risk tracking
Strong communication skills: you naturally become the connective tissue between engineers, partners, and leadership
A structured, hands-on working style and an affinity for using AI tools in your daily workflow
Fluent English. Fluent German is a strong plus for working with our partners and suppliers
Willingness to travel occasionally to our partners
Nice to have: experience with embedded systems, optics, or agile product ownership
Not ticking every box? That's okay. If this role excites you and you bring most of what we've described, we want to hear from you.
What You'll Get
Mission & Technical Challenge: At Omegga, you work on problems that are both technically demanding and globally relevant. We build deep-tech solutions with real-world impact, pushing the boundaries of what's currently possible.
Relocation Support: Moving to Munich? We help you find an apartment in the Werksviertel within walking distance of the office. We connect you with the right contacts and take the stress out of apartment hunting.
Work Environment: Located in Munich's Werksviertel, we combine a focused, high-performance culture with flexibility. Up to 50% remote work, depending on role and execution needs.
Ownership: VSOPs (Virtual Stock Options) so you share in the value you help create.
Time Off: 28 vacation days per year, plus December 24th and 31st off.

Monthly meal budget for whatever keeps you going, from quick lunches to proper team dinners
Monthly perks budget to spend where it actually matters to you — fitness, mobility, or the occasional "I earned this" purchase
Annual learning budget to invest in your growth, from conferences to deep dives into new domains
Free drinks, coffee, and snacks in the office to keep you focused throughout the day

Developing the strategic plan for the airport, aligning goals and objectives with the overall goals of OSO and TSA. Projecting short- and long-term future needs.

Developing and approving solutions to current and anticipated problems independently and establishing new policies/procedures or making exceptions to policies/procedures that impact the strategic objectives of the airport as well as internal and external customers.

Directing the work of supervisors, program managers, and other subordinate employees for multiple administrative and operational functions.

Preparing, planning, coordinating, and managing support operations that include administration, support operations, financial/budget, human resources, customer service/stakeholders, scheduling, training, procurement, safety and occupational health, logistics, and engineering services.

Conferring with the FSD and project staff personnel to outline work plans, provide technical advice, resolve problems, review status reports, and modify schedules to accomplish duties. Identifying and determining types of actions required to meet time frames and budget/funding limitations.

Managing or conducting targeted recruitment and other external marketing sources to assist in providing diverse applicant pools to the FSD. Advising/informing the FSD on unusual or complex managerial or personnel disciplinary issues. Exercising discretion and sound judgment in dealing with sensitive human resources matters or issues.

Providing data/information and reports from statistical and narrative databases in all support areas. Supervisory/Managerial duties include serving as a first line supervisor for the organization.

This includes but is not limited to: assigning work, setting priorities, and reviewing and evaluating work and performance of subordinates; approving leave; coaching and developing employees; recommending corrective or disciplinary actions; assisting in budget planning and projecting short-term needs; managing projects within assigned resources; resolving routine problems that typically impact the objectives of the organizational unit; and when required, coordinating with customers outside the immediate organization.

Emergency Essential Position: This position is designated as an Emergency Essential (EE) position. This designation requires the employee to remain in a duty status if an emergency arises.
To qualify for the SV-J Pay Band (equivalent to the GS-14), you must have one year of specialized experience equivalent to the SV-I Pay Band or GS-13 in Federal service or equivalent experience in the private sector.

Specialized experience is defined as experience that has equipped you with the particular knowledge, skills and abilities to successfully perform the duties of the position.

Such experience includes: Providing management, direction and program oversight of administrative and operations functions (e.g., Human Resources, staffing, finance/budget, equipment, etc.); Developing strategic plans; and Projecting short and long term future needs of an airport, program, or project.

Credit for experience is given based on a 40-hour workweek. Part-time experience is credited on a part-time ratio, i.e., working 20 hours per week for two months equals one month of experience. No additional credit is given for overtime.

National Service Experience (i.e., volunteer experience): Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations (e.g., professional; philanthropic; religious; spiritual; community, student, social).

Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment. You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer experience.

The Principal Project Manager is a senior delivery leader within Professional Services, responsible for the rigor, predictability, and outcomes of Cyara ’s implementation and services portfolio.

Reporting to the Senior Director, Professional Services, this is a player-coach role: you will personally own a portfolio of complex, strategic customer engagements while leading and developing a small team of Project Managers supporting customers across North America, EMEA, and APAC.

You will set the standard for how Professional Services plans, governs, reports on, and closes out customer projects — bringing PMO discipline to a global delivery organization.

Portfolio Leadership & Delivery Execution
Own a portfolio of complex, multi-phase, and strategic customer implementations and services engagements from initiation through formal completion and closure.
Lead and coach a small team of Project Managers, setting expectations, reviewing project plans, and holding the team accountable to consistent delivery standards.
Personally manage select high-value or high-complexity accounts, staying close to delivery while building the team’s ability to do the same.
Project Governance & PMO Standards
Establish consistent project-management standards, templates, and methodologies across Professional Services, covering planning, resource forecasting, effort estimation, and change control.
Define governance for complex, multi-phase, recurring, and long-duration programs, including clear criteria for closing individual phases and full projects instead of leaving them administratively open.
Build the risk management, dependency tracking, and executive escalation practices that keep engagements on track and stakeholders informed.
Cross-Functional Partnership & Executive Communication
Partner with Professional Services leadership, consultants, technical resources, Sales, and Customer Success to align delivery plans with customer commitments and business priorities.
Serve as the executive point of contact for project status, risk, and escalation on strategic accounts, communicating directly with customer sponsors and internal leadership.
Build feedback checkpoints at meaningful delivery milestones so customer satisfaction is measured throughout an engagement, not only at its conclusion.
Reporting, Financial Performance & Continuous Improvement
Own project health, milestone, budget, hours, and utilization reporting, using Rocketlane or a comparable PSA platform to give leadership real-time visibility into the portfolio.
Track forecast accuracy, time-to-value, and financial performance across the portfolio, and correct course when projects drift from plan.
Identify systemic delivery risks from portfolio data, recommend process changes, and build the playbooks, templates, and dashboards that let the PMO function scale.

Delivery Leadership & Project Management Experience
Significant experience managing complex enterprise technology implementations or Professional Services engagements, including multiple concurrent projects or portfolios.
Experience leading and developing Project Managers, with the ability and willingness to personally manage projects while also providing team leadership.
Strong executive customer communication and escalation-management skills, gained working directly with customer sponsors and internal leadership on complex engagements.
PMO & Project Management Discipline

Strong understanding of PMI-aligned project-management disciplines, including planning, risk, scope, and change management.
Experience managing project financials — budgets, hours, forecasts, and change requests — and resource plans across a portfolio of engagements.
Experience working across global, cross-functional organizations spanning multiple regions and time zones.
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in business, information technology, or a related field.

Experience with Rocketlane, Salesforce, or comparable PSA platforms preferred.
SaaS, enterprise software, CX, CCaaS, telecommunications, testing/automation, or related technology experience preferred.

You’ll bring PMO rigor to a global Professional Services organization, shaping how Cyara plans, governs, and closes customer engagements across North America, EMEA, and APAC.

Total Rewards of a Allied Health Professional The psychologist serves as a Senior Program Manager for the Outpatient Mental Health (OMH) program at the American Lake division of VA Puget Sound Health Care System (VAPSHCS) in Tacoma WA. In this capacity, the psychologist functions as the Director, OMH for the Mental Health Service Line.

The Mental Health Service at the VAPSHCS is a large and diverse integrated care line with over 400 FTEE, including psychiatrists, psychologists, social workers, nurses, and several additional clinical and administrative staff.

Senior Program Management Responsibilities (30%) Provides broad program management responsibilities of a clinical care team, including leadership in the development, implementation, evaluation, and oversight of a complex program responsible for comprehensive clinical care of Veterans.

Leads a multidisciplinary team, which includes psychologists, physicians, physician assistants, social workers, nurses, and other health care professionals and trainees.

Responsible for the development, implementation, and oversight of operational policies and procedures for the treatment team, with the approval of the affiliated Program Director and/or Service Line Leader. Monitors and distributes provider-specific workload reports to program managers and ensures provider adherence to workload standards.

Plans work to be accomplished by program managers, including establishing priorities, timelines for completion, and necessary adjustments therein. Initiates and maintains liaisons with associated VA health care programs in order to effectively coordinate services.

Supervisory Responsibilities (20%) Functions as the first line supervising authority (i.e., rater) for six Program Managers and four front-line staff members. For these individuals, the incumbent provides administrative, as well as clinical, supervision and/or consultation as appropriate.

Provides administrative oversight and clinical consultation to over 50 other interdisciplinary team members for whom the incumbent is not the designated first line rating authority. Assumes responsibility for taking appropriate disciplinary actions for employees with performance problems in a timely and effective manner.

Clinical Responsibilities (45%) Provides psychological assessment and diagnostic services for Veterans with a broad range of psychopathology receiving care within the clinic setting. Provides education to both patients and family members regarding relevant mental health concerns.

Provides comprehensive, evidence-based psychotherapeutic interventions, including individual, family, and group psychotherapy and psychoeducation. Provides consultation to health care providers about assessment findings and treatment plan for patients to ensure that care is coordinated, collaborative, and integrated within the Medical Center.

Develops, implements, and documents the mental health treatment plan for an assigned caseload of patients.

Functional Statement #: 0000000 Permanent Change of Station (PCS): Not Authorized
To qualify for this position, applicants must meet all requirements within 30 days of the closing date of this announcement. Basic Requirements: United States Citizenship: Non-citizens may only be appointed when it is not possible to recruit qualified citizens in accordance with VA Policy. English Language Proficiency.

Psychologists must be proficient in spoken and written English in accordance with VA Handbook 5005, Part II, Chapter 3, section A, paragraph 3j.

Education: Have a doctoral degree in psychology from a graduate program in psychology accredited by the American Psychological Association (APA), the Psychological Clinical Science Accreditation System (PCSAS), or the Canadian Psychological Association (CPA) at the time the program was completed.

The specialty area of the degree must be consistent with the assignment for which the applicant is to be employed. For the purpose of meeting this requirement, the term "specialty area" refers to the specific specialty areas recognized by the accrediting body and not to specific job duties that might require special skills.

Currently, APA accredits doctoral programs in the specialty areas of clinical psychology, counseling psychology, school psychology, or combinations of two or more of those areas. PCSAS accredits doctoral programs in psychological clinical science.

CPA accredits doctoral programs in clinical psychology, counseling psychology, clinical neuropsychology, and school psychology. There are no job assignments in VHA that require the skills of a school psychologist; therefore, an applicant with a degree in the specialty area of school psychology is not eligible for appointment.

Strictly for the purpose of determining eligibility for appointment as a psychologist in VHA, there is no distinction between the specialty areas (with the exception of school psychology).

OR Have a doctoral degree in any area of psychology and, in addition, successfully complete a re- specialization program (including documentation of an approved internship completed as part of the re- specialization program) meeting both of the following conditions: The re-specialization program must be completed in an APA or a CPA accredited doctoral program; and, the specialty in which the applicant is retrained must be consistent with the assignment for which the applicant is to be employed.

NOTE: The applicant must provide an official transcript and/or certificate documenting the completion of the re-specialization program, which includes completion of an APA or CPA internship.

Psychologists who have successfully completed a re-specialization program as described above and who were employed by the Department of Veterans Affairs prior to the implementation of this standard are considered to have fully met the educational requirements of these qualification standards.

OR Have a doctoral degree awarded between 1951 and 1978 from a regionally-accredited institution, with a dissertation primarily psychological in nature.

Internship: Have successfully completed a professional psychology internship training program that was accredited by APA or CPA at the time the program was completed and that is consistent with the assignment for which the applicant is to be employed.

OR New VHA psychology internship programs that are in the process of applying for APA accreditation are acceptable in fulfillment of the internship requirement, provided that such programs were sanctioned by the VHA Central Office Program Director for Psychology and the VHA Office of Academic Affiliations at the time that the individual was an intern; OR VHA facilities that offered full-time, one-year pre-doctoral internships prior to PL 96- 151 (pre- 1979) are considered to be acceptable in fulfillment of the internship requirement; OR Applicants who completed an internship that was not accredited by APA or CPA at the time the program was completed may be considered eligible for hire only if they are currently board certified by the American Board of Professional Psychology in a specialty area that is consistent with the assignment for which the applicant is to be employed.

(NOTE: Once board certified, the employee is required to maintain board certification.) OR Applicants who have a doctoral degree awarded between 1951 and 1978 from a regionally- accredited institution with a dissertation primarily psychological in nature may fulfill this internship requirement by having the equivalent of a one-year supervised internship experience in a site specifically acceptable to the candidate's doctoral program.

If the internship experience is not noted on the applicant's official transcript, the applicant must provide a statement from the doctoral program verifying that the equivalent of a one-year supervised internship experience was completed in a site acceptable to the doctoral program. Licensure.

Hold a full, current, and unrestricted license to practice psychology at the doctoral level in a State, Territory, or Commonwealth of the United States, or the District of Columbia.

May qualify based on being covered by the Grandfathering Provision as described in the VA Qualification Standard for this occupation (only applicable to current VHA employees who are in this occupation and meet the criteria). Grade Determinations: Senior Psychologist Program Manager, GS-15 Experience.

At least four years of experience as a professional psychologist, with at least one year equivalent to the GS-14 grade level. Demonstrated Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities.

In addition to the experience above, the candidate must demonstrate all of the following KSAs: Skill in managing and directing the work of large, complex organizational units and in applying effective management practices. Skill in persuasion, negotiation, and motivation to negotiate multiple program policies.

Skill in interpersonal relationships in dealing with employees and other managers using advanced consultation and problem solving skills. Skill in the application and analysis of measurement tools to systems issues.

Ability to balance responsibilities in a complex environment and to work with great autonomy; ability to set priorities and delegate tasks, meet multiple deadlines, analyze complex organizational problems; and ability to develop and implement effective solutions for those problems.

Ability to assess need for basic and complex services across multiple programmatic contexts. Ability to coordinate the efforts of multiple program elements across a complex system. Reference: For more information on this qualification standard, please visit https://www.va.gov/ohrm/QualificationStandards/.

The full performance level of this vacancy is GS-15. Physical Requirements: There are no physical requirements for this occupation per OCHCO Communications email to VA Handbook 5019, updated on 4/17/2026.

Agora Industry Are you passionate about biomass feedstocks as a means to decarbonise heavy industry applications? Do you bring expertise in the technical, economic and climate policy aspects of biomass availability, processing and use? Are you excited to work in a diverse, multi-disciplinary and international team? Then, this is the perfect opportunity for you!
Reaching a climate-neutral industry will require unprecedented investments in a wide range of GHG mitigation technologies, due to the sector’s inherent complexity and regional diversity.

While a significant share of emissions can be reduced by advancing energy efficiency and expanding direct electrification powered by renewable energy, there is also the need for more complex and costly measures as well as alternative feedstocks for processes, where biomass and hydrogen technologies can be implemented.

To tap into this potential, climate-effective biomass uses in industry require thorough understanding of availability and costs across different regions to give recommendations on policies that help to decarbonise industry in a competitive way, incorporating ecological sustainability boundaries.

Under the umbrella of the Agora Think Tanks, Agora Industry develops politically feasible and science-based strategies and solutions for the transformation to climate neutrality – in Germany, Europe, and internationally.

As a think tank and policy lab we facilitate a productive exchange of ideas amongst stakeholders from politics, business, science and civil society. As a non-partisan, non-profit organisation funded by foundations and public institutions, we are independent of corporate and partisan interests.

Our exclusive mission is to serve the climate and the common good.To strengthen our team, we are looking for a
Project Manager or Project Officer Biomass Value Chains (f/m/d)
Full- or part-time (min. 32 hours)– based in Berlin
You will work on the supply side of biomass as a feedstock for hard-to-electrify applications in industry. The geographical scope will be global, covering different conditions and contexts that vary across geographies. Conducting and coordinating projects on biomass for industrial applications and related technological enablers and policy support mechanisms
Analysing policy and regulatory gaps that hinder biomass use in various regions with a focus on economic, regulatory, and governance frameworks.
Monitoring the development of technology and business models related to the scaling, mobilization and system integration of biomass value chains and logistics.
Supporting stakeholder engagement with policymakers, industry, civil society, funders, among others, to inform discussions around biomass applications across different industry sectors.
Pro-actively contributing to building partnerships and working closely with network partners across the globe.

Actively contributing to internal discussions.

**Intitulé du poste** **: Responsable mondial des ressources humaines**
**Durée du contrat : Permanent**
**Lieu : Siège de PSI, Genève, Suisse**

**Équipe : Opérations mondiales**
**Résumé :**
Le poste est responsable du développement et de la mise en œuvre des politiques, procédures et outils stratégiques et opérationnels en matière de ressources humaines des opérations mondiales de PSI afin de soutenir la réalisation des objectifs politiques de PSI - y compris la supervision de la planification stratégique du personnel, l'amélioration continue, l'engagement des employés, la performance et le bien-être. Il joue un rôle clé dans la promotion de la culture de PSI.
**Principales responsabilités :**
**Stratégie RH & Leadership organisationnel**
Développer et mettre en œuvre une stratégie mondiale des ressources humaines qui soutient les priorités politiques de PSI, la durabilité organisationnelle et les besoins à long terme en personnel.

Agir en tant que conseiller stratégique auprès de l'équipe de direction (SMT) sur les questions liées au personnel, à l'efficacité organisationnelle, à la planification des effectifs, à la gestion des talents et au dialogue social, y compris avec les représentants syndicaux et du personnel.

Mener des initiatives de conception organisationnelle et de gestion du changement visant à renforcer l'efficacité opérationnelle, l'engagement des employés et la résilience organisationnelle.

Développer et mettre en œuvre des politiques, pratiques et initiatives en matière de ressources humaines alignées sur les valeurs, la culture et les objectifs stratégiques de PSI.
**Opérations mondiales RH & Conformité**
Superviser la prestation des opérations RH mondiales dans tous les sites de PSI, en garantissant cohérence, efficacité et conformité à la législation locale du travail et aux politiques organisationnelles.

Diriger et améliorer continuellement les processus liés au personnel, y compris le recrutement, l'intégration, la gestion du cycle de vie des employés, l'administration des contrats et la sortie des employés.

Assurer la conformité légale et réglementaire dans toutes les régions et bureaux pays, en atténuant les risques liés à l'emploi et en maintenant les meilleures pratiques RH. Gérer les systèmes RH mondiaux, les dossiers, les rapports et les analyses du personnel pour soutenir la prise de décisions éclairées.
**Gestion des talents & Développement des employés**
Diriger les processus mondiaux de planification des effectifs et de planification de la succession pour assurer la continuité organisationnelle et les capacités futures.

Développer et mettre en œuvre des initiatives d'apprentissage, de développement du leadership et de progression de carrière qui renforcent la performance organisationnelle et l'engagement des employés.

Superviser les processus de gestion de la performance, en veillant à ce que les managers soient équipés pour soutenir la haute performance et le développement professionnel. Promouvoir une culture d'apprentissage continu, de feedback et de responsabilité à travers l'organisation.
**Relations avec les employés, bien-être & inclusion**
Promouvoir un lieu de travail diversifié, équitable, inclusif et psychologiquement sûr où tous les employés peuvent s'épanouir. Mener des initiatives liées au bien-être des employés, à la santé et sécurité, et au devoir de diligence dans tous les sites de PSI.

Fournir des conseils experts sur des questions complexes de relations avec les employés, la résolution de conflits et les enquêtes en milieu de travail lorsque nécessaire. Favoriser un dialogue social positif et un engagement constructif avec les représentants des employés et syndicats.
**Partenariat RH**
Servir de partenaire RH mondial pour les managers et le personnel du siège, des bureaux régionaux et des bureaux pays. Soutenir les leaders dans la gestion du personnel, le développement des équipes, la gestion de la performance, la planification des effectifs et l'engagement des employés.

Coacher et conseiller les managers sur l'efficacité du leadership, les relations avec les employés, le développement des talents et le changement organisationnel. Permettre aux managers de prendre des décisions efficaces en matière de personnel grâce à des analyses basées sur les données et des conseils RH pratiques.
**Rémunération, avantages & planification des effectifs**
Diriger le développement et la révision des cadres mondiaux de rémunération et d'avantages sociaux pour garantir compétitivité, équité et alignement avec les objectifs organisationnels. Soutenir les revues salariales, la planification des effectifs et les négociations relatives aux conditions d'emploi et aux avantages du personnel.

Collaborer étroitement avec l'équipe financière sur la planification des effectifs, le budget des ressources humaines, les coûts du personnel et les rapports financiers liés aux RH. Contribuer au développement de stratégies d'investissement durable en personnel qui soutiennent la croissance et l'efficacité organisationnelles.

Amazon Extra Large (AMXL) is a single-threaded organization that owns the end-to-end customer experience for heavy and bulky products, from supply chain and fulfillment through transportation, last mile delivery, and post-purchase resolution. AMXL currently operates across North America, Europe, Japan, and is expanding into emerging markets.

Within AMXL, the CX and Growth org is a centralized, worldwide team organized across five pillars designed to ensure that every customer who purchases a large, high-value product receives a reliable experience.
The Execution Excellence pillar is where planning meets the customer. It houses two complementary teams: our AMXL Operations Center and our AMXL Proactive Execution program.

These teams serve as the real-time network execution backbone, translating strategic decisions into daily network performance across our end-to-end network and also as the mechanism that identifies delivery failures before they become visible to the customer and intervenes proactively to save the delivery or manage the recovery directly with the customer.

Together, these teams form a closed loop: detect upstream, prevent where possible, intervene proactively where not, and feed root causes back so defects are resolved at the source.
We are seeking a Senior Program Manager to lead the integration and transformation of this combined organization. This is not a steady-state program management role. The program strategy is being built.

You will inherit a consolidation in progress and own the lifecycle of making it work: assessing what the combined org should look like, defining how we measure success, building the mechanisms that make it sustainable, and driving the hard conversations required to get there.

You will use process lifecycle evaluation methodologies to categorize the team's portfolio (automate, simplify, reallocate, or deprecate), and build automation roadmaps in partnership with technical teams.
This role requires someone who can operate in high ambiguity, make trade-offs between short-term operational needs and long-term strategic goals, and communicate persuasively across teams. The right candidate sees automation and AI as something they use today, not something they plan to use later, and will set the standard for how this team uses technology to scale impact without scaling headcount.

· Define the operating model for the combined organization: org design, process rationalization, scope definition, and mechanisms that make it self-sustaining.
· Build the process lifecycle evaluation framework, determining which workflows to automate, simplify, reallocate, or retire, and manage the pipeline of new use cases from scoping through launch.
· Own the automation roadmap in partnership with data science, engineering, and technology teams, establishing accountability mechanisms with clear timelines for every manual process.
· Drive cross-functional stakeholder alignment across supply chain, quality, and operations, navigating complex organizational dynamics and building trust where needed.
· Scale this capability into new geographies by adapting the operating model to local carrier ecosystems, regulatory environments, and workforce availability.
A day in the life
You might start your morning reviewing program metrics dashboards, identifying areas that need attention, and preparing a status narrative for a director-level review. By mid-morning you are facilitating a working session with partners to align on priorities for the quarter.

After lunch you dive into data to validate assumptions behind a proposed solution, then draft a decision document that frames trade-offs for leadership. You close the day mentoring a newer program manager and connecting with cross-regional counterparts to keep workstreams on track.
